dialogues.speaker: Amber
dialogues.text: You know that magical bird I told you about? The one I spent three days hunting? I still wear the feather I took as a trophy on my waist.

dialogues.speaker: Amber
dialogues.text: There's nothing like finally defeating your enemy after a long, hard battle. It's like biting into a delicious steak when you're starving hungry!

dialogues.speaker: Amber
dialogues.text: So, whatever happens — don't give up!
